ThingDef.label: draft harness
ThingDef.description: An assembly of straps, laces and buckles cut from leather, the foundation of all draft work. A handler buckles it onto a draft beast (horses, donkeys, cattle, muffalo, bison, yaks, dromedaries, elephants and any species ticked in the mod options) before hitching a plow, a cart or a snow scraper to it. It frays slowly with every plowed cell, cleared cell and loaded stack, lasting well over a thousand jobs in plain leather, half again as long in a heavy hide and twice as long in thrumbofur.
